title: Installation Guide
summary: Get up and running with Ollama locally on macOS, Windows, and Linux.

title: Quickstart
summary: Pull your first model and start chatting with Ollama in under 5 minutes.

title: Configuration
summary: Configure Ollama with environment variables: OLLAMA_HOST, OLLAMA_MODELS, OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE, and more.

title: Model Library
summary: Browse available Ollama models: Llama 3, Mistral, Phi-3, Gemma, and more. Pull and manage models from the CLI.

title: Custom Models (Modelfile)
summary: Create, customize, and share Ollama models using Modelfile syntax. Set system prompts, temperature, and context window.

title: Importing GGUF Models
summary: Import GGUF quantized models from HuggingFace or local files into Ollama using Modelfile.

title: REST API Reference
summary: Complete reference for the Ollama REST API: /api/generate, /api/chat, /api/embeddings, /api/tags, and more.

title: Python Library
summary: Use the official ollama Python library for async and sync model inference, streaming, and embeddings.

title: JavaScript Library
summary: Use ollama.js in Node.js or the browser. Supports streaming chat, generate, and embeddings endpoints.

title: GPU Acceleration
summary: Enable GPU acceleration for faster inference. Covers NVIDIA CUDA, AMD ROCm, and Apple Silicon (Metal) backends.

title: Multi-GPU Setup
summary: Distribute model layers across multiple NVIDIA or AMD GPUs for large model inference and improved throughput.

title: Docker Deployment
summary: Deploy Ollama with Docker and docker-compose. Includes GPU passthrough, volume mounts, and networking.

title: Error: llama runner process has terminated
summary: Often caused by out-of-memory (OOM) issues or incompatible CUDA drivers. Step-by-step fix with driver downgrade and OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE.

title: Cannot connect to Ollama from Docker container
summary: Set OLLAMA_HOST=0.0.0.0 to allow external connections from Docker containers. Includes docker-compose example.

title: High CPU usage when idle on Windows
summary: Resolving background processes not terminating correctly on Windows by configuring sleep duration and WSL2 settings.

title: GPU Not Detected — NVIDIA/AMD
summary: Ollama falls back to CPU. Fix with CUDA driver update for NVIDIA or ROCm setup for AMD on Linux.

title: CORS error when calling Ollama API from browser
summary: Set OLLAMA_ORIGINS environment variable to your app's origin to allow cross-origin requests from the browser.

title: GGUF model import fails with 'invalid model'
summary: Some GGUF files are incompatible. Use llama.cpp convert script or download a pre-quantized GGUF from HuggingFace.

title: Slow inference speed — GPU not utilized
summary: Inference runs entirely on CPU. Diagnose with ollama ps and check CUDA/ROCm library path.

title: Docker GPU not recognized inside container
summary: Add --gpus=all flag and install NVIDIA Container Toolkit to expose GPU to the Ollama Docker container.
